positive.prompt: Sinh test automation code từ Gherkin
Generate automation test từ feature files
Viết test code cho scenarios đã có
Tạo automation test từ test design

negative.prompt: Import tài liệu từ Jira Confluence
Thiết kế checklist kiểm thử và kịch bản BDD

evals.prompt: Generate automation test code từ Gherkin feature file với 10 scenarios
evals.expected_output: Complete pytest test files với step definitions, reusable functions, và proper structure
expectations: All Gherkin scenarios have corresponding test code
Step definitions implemented (@given, @when, @then)
Reusable helper functions extracted (not duplicated code)
Proper test structure (setup, teardown, fixtures)
No hardcoded credentials or secrets
Code passes syntax validation
Output saved to workspace/{issueKey}/test/steps/
Confidence level based on coverage and quality

evals.prompt: Generate API automation tests với authentication, validation, và error handling
evals.expected_output: API test code covering happy path + edge cases + error scenarios
expectations: Authentication handled properly (JWT/Bearer token)
Request validation tests (invalid params, missing fields)
Response validation tests (status codes, schema, data)
Error scenario tests (timeout, 4xx, 5xx)
Logging added for failed requests (request + response)
Retry logic for flaky endpoints (if needed)
Scanned openapi-tyk/sdk/python/ and reused official SDK
All test variables, endpoints, and credentials externalized to .env (zero hardcoding in test scripts)

evals.prompt: Viết test assertions cho API trả về trạng thái lệnh nhưng Jira Acceptance Criteria chưa nêu rõ mã lỗi khi bị từ chối
evals.expected_output: Agent tuân thủ Grounding Rule, gắn comment # NEEDS-SPEC và dừng hỏi lại thay vì tự bịa mã lỗi hoặc tự đoán số liệu
expectations: Agent strictly adheres to grounding-contract.md and No-Inference Rule
Agent refuses to guess or assume expected error codes not documented in AC/Spec
Marks assertions with # NEEDS-SPEC comment
Does not copy mock numbers from Few-shot examples
Recommends invoking ba-interview-me to clarify acceptance criteria
